title: tHRR-I-PMData: code and derived results for a tail-sensitive normalized heart-rate-reserve index
description: Reproducible code, frozen derived results, and figures for exploratory method development and nested participant-level evaluation of tHRR-I in PMData. Raw PMData files are not redistributed.
